name: viaduct
description: Describe a circuit board and get a manufacturable KiCad PCB: requirements, parts, schematic, placement, autorouting, ERC/DRC and fab outputs. Downloads its open-source engine on first use, after asking.

fab_house.title: Default PCB manufacturer
fab_house.description: Who you usually order boards from. Sets the BOM and pick-and-place format and the design rules Claude aims for.

build_method.title: How boards get built
build_method.description: Assembled by the manufacturer allows small parts (0402/0603) and prefers stocked parts; hand soldering keeps parts at 0805 or larger.

layers.title: Default layer count
layers.description: Auto lets the AI pick from the design's complexity (and explains why); 2 is cheapest; 4 and 6 add solid ground and power planes.

learning.title: Learn from my boards
learning.description: Remember which layouts and routing strategies worked so future boards go faster. Stored only on this computer.
